svg.title: Присед на одной ноге в Смите — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Single-leg Smith machine squat, front three-quarter view. Show two fixed vertical rails and a single horizontal guided bar attached via sliders, resting across upper back on rear shoulders. Hands grip it at each side of shoulders. Both panels: exactly ONE working foot fixed flat on the floor beneath the bar; the other leg points diagonally forward with its foot CLEARLY HOVERING above floor throughout. Left: tall on working leg. Right: hips lowered, working knee bends while heel stays down, free leg stays in air forward, the same bar and sliders have moved down vertical rails. Not a lunge; do not place the free foot on any support. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
